_note: FHFA baseline conforming loan limits (one-unit property, most of the US). 2026: OWNER-VERIFIED — the project owner read the value $832,750 in FHFA's official news release "FHFA Announces Conforming Loan Limit Values for 2026" (dated November 25, 2025) at the URL below and confirmed it on 2026-09-29. 2023 and 2025: www.fhfa.gov is blocked by this environment's egress proxy for curl and WebFetch (EGRESS_BLOCKED, checked 2026-09-28); their quotes are the text of the FHFA releases as returned by the WebSearch tool for those exact fhfa.gov URLs (search-index excerpt, not owner-verified). Internal consistency: 832,750 - 26,250 = 806,500. Cross-check in our own data: HMDA 2025 flag conforming_loan_limit (C/NC) is county-specific; every loan in the large-character band (< $720,000) is below all three values.

2023.quote: In most of the United States, the 2023 conforming loan limit (CLL) value for one-unit properties is $726,200, an increase of $79,000 from $647,200 in 2022.

2025.quote: In most of the United States, the 2025 CLL value for one-unit properties will be $806,500, an increase of $39,950 (or 5.2 percent) from 2024.

2026.releaseTitle: FHFA Announces Conforming Loan Limit Values for 2026
2026.quote: In most of the United States, the 2026 conforming loan limit (CLL) value for one-unit properties will be $832,750, an increase of $26,250 from 2025.
2026.ceilingQuote: the new ceiling loan limit for one-unit properties will be $1,249,125, which is 150 percent of $832,750.
